name: Arunjyoti Bio Ventures Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1986, Arunjyoti Bio Ventures Ltd is a co-packer, specializing in providing high-quality co-packing services for MNCs.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company (previously known as Century 21st Portfolio Limited) used to trade in equities and commodities, had wealth management and portfolio and software development operations. On July 20th 2022, company amended its main objects by adding FMCG and beverages sector apart from carrying out the existing business activities of Bio pesticides, fertilizers and agri inputs.

pros: Debtor days have improved from 88.1 to 52.0 days.
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 354 days to 117 days
cons: Stock is trading at 4.60 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -9.73% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
